# XP-Pen

> XP-Pen is a leading manufacturer of digital drawing tablets, pen displays, and stylus technology for creative professionals and beginners.

XP-Pen specializes in graphic drawing tablets and pen display monitors with advanced pressure sensitivity, color accuracy, and innovative display technologies. Their product range spans from portable beginner-friendly tablets to professional-grade 4K and OLED displays with Calman-verified color accuracy.

## Key Topics

- Drawing tablets
- Pen displays
- Stylus technology
- X3 Pro Smart Chip Stylus
- 16K pressure sensitivity
- 4K OLED displays
- X-Paper Display
- Calman-verified color accuracy
- Adobe RGB color space
- Display P3
- X-Color Master technology
- Pressure levels
- Digital art tools
- Portable displays
- Creative professionals
